description: Guide a student through building a complete moving average crossover trading system from scratch — from loading data, computing indicators, generating signals, running a backtest, to interpreting results and iterating on parameters.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I want to build my first trading strategy from scratch. I've heard moving averages are a good starting point. I know basic Python but nothing about finance or backtesting. Where do I even begin?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I want to build a complete MA crossover system — data loading, signal generation, backtest, and performance analysis. I'm comfortable with Python and pandas. What's a clean architecture for this?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm building a reference MA crossover system as a baseline for more complex strategies. I want clean modular code, vectorized backtest, transaction cost modeling, and proper walk-forward validation. Let's architect this properly.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student has a complete, working MA crossover trading system with data loading, indicator computation, signal generation, backtesting, and performance reporting. Student understands each component and can iterate on parameters.

required_capabilities.evidence: discusses Sharpe, return, drawdown and suggests parameter changes
